description:
Accessible Windows hardware information, monitoring, reporting, and troubleshooting.

Sensor Readout is an accessibility-first Windows hardware information and troubleshooting tool for reading sensors, checking connected devices, investigating audio latency, reviewing system and accessibility details, creating support reports, monitoring remote computers, and controlling supported fans with a keyboard-first, screen-reader-friendly interface.
- Portable copies no longer redirect Windows startup away from another installed copy.
- Alarms can warn once until their condition clears, avoiding repeated reminders for persistent warnings.
